title: Warm Flaky Venezuelan Chicken Empanadas
description: Tangy and flaky Venezuelan empanadas filled with chicken and Thai sweet basil, perfect for a low glycemic meal prep option.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and cook the chicken until browned and cooked through.
Add the chopped Thai sweet basil, salt, and pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
In a small bowl, whisk together the kombu cold extract and lime juice.
Add the kombu mixture to the skillet and stir to combine.
Roll out the empanada dough and cut into circles.
Place a tablespoon of the chicken mixture onto the center of each dough circle.
Fold the dough in half and press the edges to seal.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with olive oil and bake for 20 minutes.
